authenticity_review: The image demonstrates strong structural fidelity for electric guitars: correct Stratocaster-style silhouettes, functional components (pickups, bridges, knobs, tuning pegs), and proper material rendering (glossy finish, wood necks, metal hardware). However, two AI artifacts reduce authenticity: (1) Headstock logos are illegible gibberish—visually mimicking text structure but containing no readable characters, a classic generative failure. (2) The spotted texture appears unnaturally flat and uniformly mapped across curved 3D surfaces without perspective distortion or depth variation expected from physical paint. These are moderate-severity issues that don't compromise object recognition but indicate synthetic origin. The topology auditor's high mask confidence (0.92) supports clean boundaries, and perceptual quality shows no noise/compression artifacts.
key_defects: Headstock logos are illegible AI-generated scribbles instead of readable brand text (severity 2)
Spotted pattern lacks realistic 3D surface distortion; appears flat-mapped onto curved guitar bodies (severity 1)
